bookingOpens: Online on Guestonline from the restaurant's website, by phone or by email. Open Wednesday to Saturday, 12pm to 2pm and 7pm to 8:15pm.
cancellation: Every booking is guaranteed with a card hold. Nothing is charged for cancelling more than 72 hours ahead; for a no-show or a cancellation within 72 hours, the amount of the hold is charged.
groups: Private dining and events are handled by the Pré Catelan's salons team on +33 1 44 14 41 00.
dressCode: Elegant dress. Men are asked to wear a jacket, and shorts and sportswear are not allowed; the restaurant may refuse entry if the dress code isn't followed.
